Name: Tomorrownight NPC - English Translation
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[size=3]Experience a whole new level of adventure in Pelican Town, introducing a captivating character like no other. A cat person who is shrouded by mystery, leaving you wanting to learn more.

Through your time together, you will slowly uncover the gentle and adorable qualities of this young cat, and find yourself drawn to their charm. Every moment with them will leave you wanting more, as you try to unravel the mysteries surrounding their existence.

If you're looking for a fresh new perspective on your favorite game, this mod is definitely worth the download. This cat NPC will add a new dimension to your gameplay, and you'll be hooked on their captivating presence.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience Pelican Town like never before. Download our mod today and get ready to be whisked away on an unforgettable adventure with this mysterious and enchanting cat NPC.[/size]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3]This mod includes:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Adds a brand new NPC to your game: Mingye/Tomorrownight![/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Completely Marriageable![/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Configurable name, choose between Mingye (Original Chinese Name) or Tomorrownight (Westernized Name)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Heart Events: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and two 14 Heart Events![/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Choose between two high resolution portraits! (Potraiture Mod is required)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Complete pre and post marriage dialogues, movie dialogues, and seasonal dialogues.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Exclusive and unique spouse room.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
THIS MOD IS ORIGINALLY MADE BY [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16084]Nightcat[/url] (Check out their other amazing mods!)[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15635]
[/url]This is just a translation, the original mod is in Chinese
All rights and credits are reserved to them

Personal Note:
[spoiler][i]I really love this mod, Mingye/Tomorrownight is such a unique NPC with a d[/i][i]istinctive personality and background story. Mods like these deserve to be translated into every language![/i][/spoiler]
Note for Mod Users:
[spoiler]You may find it weird that Mingye/Tomorrownight would call you as "Dear/My Dear Friend". I'm sorry if that's the case, but I can assure you that this was intended. In the original mod, Mingye/Tomorrownight uses the word "小朋友吗", which literally mean "little one" or "kid". However, it's important to note that this word have different contextual meanings and in this case, they serve as a term of endearment from Mingye/Tomorrownight towards the Farmer. This is because Mingye/Tomorrownight sees the farmer as someone who is little or someone who could depend on them and does not imply anything about the farmer being much younger than Mingye/Tomorrownight. With that said, "Dear/My Dear Friend" is the closest translation that I could come up with. If you have other suggestion to replace these words, please let me know.[/spoiler]

After that, when you talk to Tomorrownight in game, press 'P' to change the portrait.
